description: This file defines protocols, extensions, and support functions for managing location services, including configuration, authorization status, and asynchronous location requests, in a Swift project related to location handling.

methods.name: configureLocationManager
methods.description: Configures the CLLocationManager instance with delegate and desired accuracy.

methods.name: authorizationStatus
methods.description: Returns the current authorization status for location services.

methods.name: accuracyAuthorization
methods.description: Returns the accuracy authorization status for location services, with compatibility for different OS versions.

methods.name: requestLocationOnce
methods.description: Asynchronously requests a single location update, using continuations to handle async flow.

methods.name: accuracyAuthorization (in LocationServiceSupport)
methods.description: Provides the accuracy authorization status, compatible with iOS 14+ and macOS 11+.

methods.name: requestLocation (in LocationServiceSupport)
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous location request, integrating with Swift's async/await pattern.
